bachelor.en: Pick a specific bachelor’s programme on the official site and read its own entry page (requirements differ between faculties).
bachelor.uz: Rasmiy saytda aniq bakalavr dasturini tanlang va uning o‘z qabul sahifasini o‘qing (fakultetlar talabi farq qiladi).

bachelor.en: Ask the university whether your 11-year certificate is accepted directly or whether you need a foundation/pre-university year.
bachelor.uz: Universitetdan 11 yillik attestatingiz to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qabul qilinadimi yoki foundation/pre-university yili kerakmi, so‘rang.

bachelor.en: Take the language test or exam the programme accepts (check which tests are accepted, not just the score).
bachelor.uz: Dastur qabul qiladigan til testi yoki imtihonini topshiring (faqat ballni emas, qaysi test qabul qilinishini ham tekshiring).

bachelor.en: Prepare the documents and certified translations; write the motivation letter.
bachelor.uz: Hujjatlar va tasdiqlangan tarjimalarni tayyorlang; motivatsion xat yozing.

bachelor.en: Submit the application and pay the fee on the official portal before the deadline (note the time zone).
bachelor.uz: Arizani rasmiy portalda muddatdan oldin topshiring va to‘lovni amalga oshiring (vaqt zonasiga e’tibor bering).

bachelor.en: Apply for grants separately — they have their own deadlines and conditions.
bachelor.uz: Grantlarga alohida topshiring — ularning o‘z muddati va shartlari bor.

bachelor.en: After the result: read the offer conditions, then arrange funding, visa and housing through official sources.
bachelor.uz: Natijadan keyin: taklif (offer) shartlarini o‘qing, so‘ng moliyalashtirish, viza va turar joyni rasmiy manbalar orqali hal qiling.
